Color.note: DXT1 unless the alpha channel carries real data. Mips built in linear space.

_NRM.note: DXT5nm: x in alpha, y in green. Unity UnpackNormal ignores red and blue.

Height.note: Never block-compressed. Changing scale or offset moves terrain under landed craft and must be coordinated with RSS.

Biomes.note: Exact RGB lookup against biome definitions. Never compressed, never mipped, point filtered.

topo30.description: Global 30 arc-second land topography and ocean bathymetry.
topo30.note: Verified against the shipped EarthHeight: TopoConv -autoscale -autooffset reports heightscale 3.3426 (deformity 19606) and heightoffs 10921, exactly the values in RSS Earth.cfg. Between 62S and 51N the regenerated map is 98-99% identical to the shipped one. Antarctica and Greenland are NOT: this DEM lacks the ice-surface fill the shipped map has, and sits 2690 m lower over Antarctica and 976 m lower over Greenland. See tools/convert/README.md.
topo30.assetNote: Name of the release asset on KSP-RO/RSS-Textures-Source carrying this DEM, fetched by tools/convert/heights.mjs --sources. Published raw rather than zipped: at 1.74 GiB it is inside GitHub's 2 GiB per-asset limit, and a zip that size cannot be inflated in memory. Change this one field if the release names it differently.
